incidents.summary: Courts required Fresnillo to compensate the El Bajío community for illegally extracted gold, with a June 2026 decision requiring further justification of the disputed valuation without questioning the rest of the judgment.

sources.title: Fresnillo faces $630m demand to restore 'illegally mined' gold – SourceMaterial
sources.quote: Since 2013 it has been blocked from mining gold from the Soledad-Dipolos open-pit mine after a court found that it did not have the legal authorisation.
